routes.notes: displays login form with username and password fields
authenticates user; redirects to /home on success, back to /login on failure

observations: Login form accepts username and password via POST request.
Authentication error message is generic: 'Authentication failed.'
Source inspection reveals two input sanitization functions applied before the SQL query.
The SQL query uses ES6 template literal string interpolation, not parameterized queries.
Password is SHA-256 hashed before query, but username is inserted directly after filtering.
